nodes.label: A use case of the graph lives outside the engine; the factory is the first
nodes.summary: A use case of the graph lives in a repository of its own, as a pack that carries its vocabulary, its code and its plugin, reaches the engine only through the pack seams, and is listed in the registry; the factory is the first, and the engine's repository forgets it.
